description: This file defines the SessionManager class, which manages media playback sessions, including queue operations, session states, and interactions with a Player interface. It handles adding, removing, seeking media items, and controls playback states such as pause, resume, and stop.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A class that manages a media session, handling playlist operations, session lifecycle, and delegating playback to a Player interface.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a media session is currently valid.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Returns the current session ID as a string if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: getCurrentItem
methods.description: Returns the current media playlist item, or null if playlist is empty.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns cached statistics info from the Player.

methods.name: getPlaylist
methods.description: Returns the current playlist.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously updates media session and playlist status, invoking onPlaylistReady() when finished.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new media item to the playlist with specified URI and MIME type, optionally with a PendingIntent receiver.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a media item from the playlist by its item ID.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within a media item identified by item ID.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific media item by ID.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback, clears playlist, and resets playback state.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new media session, incrementing session ID and setting session as valid.

methods.name: endSession
methods.description: Ends the current media session.

methods.name: getSessionStatus
methods.description: Returns the current session status, including whether it is active and paused state.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends current playback, saving position and setting current item to pending.

methods.name: unsuspend
methods.description: Resumes playback, re-establishing queue and playback states with a new player.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Callback invoked on playback error; stops current item.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: Callback invoked on playback completion; advances to next item.

methods.name: onPlaylistChanged
methods.description: Callback for playlist change; updates status.

methods.name: onPlaylistReady
methods.description: Callback when playlist is ready; typically triggers UI update.

methods.name: setPlayer
methods.description: Associates a Player implementation with this SessionManager.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets an external callback to notify UI of state changes.
